info.title: eLinx
info.description: The eLinx API allows you to create and manage elinx.

post.description:
This endpoint is used to create an eLinx request. Once the eLinx request is created successfully, the request link will be sent through an email to the recipient.

Notes:

* If you do not wish to send an eLinx request via an email, sms or whatsapp, then simply set SendNotification = false

* Before sending an eLinx request, you must set your default email address using the /elinx/setup-sender-email endpoint.

SenderName.description: Sender's full name. This is the name of the person who is sending the eLinx request to the recipient.

ReceiverName.description: Receiver's full name. This is the name of the person receiving the eLinx request.

PaymentType.description: Only required if you are requesting banking info for the purposes of a payment. Valid options are fund or withdraw. Choose fund if you are sending an eLinx request to collect money, and withdraw if you sending an eLinx request to send money.

BankingPaymentRail.description: Determines the payment rail to use for transactions involving banking rails. Possible values: eft, vopayinstant, ach, rtp, fednow, fedwire

Amount.description: The amount of the payment you are requesting in the eLinx. If an amount is specified, a transaction will be created once the eLinx request is fulfilled by the recipient.

Frequency.description: Only required if you are requesting banking info for a scheduled/recurring payment. Valid options are single or recurring.

NameOfFrequency.description: Name of frequency of the scheduled transaction (Only for recurring option), the posibles values are: daily, weekdays, weekly, bi-weekly, semi-monthly, monthly, quarterly, semi-annually, annually. Required if you are sending an eLinx request for a recurring payment.

ScheduleStartDate.description: Date from which the schedule will be started in YYYY-MM-DD format. Required if you are sending an eLinx for a recurring/scheduled payment.

ScheduleEndDate.description: Date when the transaction processing will end (Only for recurring option). Either provide ScheduleEndDate or EndingAfterPayments. One is required if you are sending an eLinx for a recurring payment.

EndingAfterPayments.description: Number of payments after which the transaction processing will end (Only for recurring option). Either provide ScheduleEndDate or EndingAfterPayments. One is required if you are sending an eLinx for a recurring payment.

SemiMonthlyFrequencyType.description: Type of semi-monthly frequency. This field is only required when NameOfFrequency is set to semi-monthly. The possible values are: SemiMonthFirstAndFifteenth, SemiMonthFifteenthAndLast.

DocumentID.description: ID of the document you want to include in the eLinx email. You must first upload a document using the POST /document endpoint, and then pass in the resulting DocumentID into this endpoint.

ClientReferenceNumber.description: An optional reference number which was associated with the eLinx request.

Note.description: An optional note to associate with the transaction.

SendNotification.description: This option is used to send an eLinx through email, sms, or whatsapp which later on can be used by a recipient to make the payment. A valid ReceiverPhoneNumber or ReceiverEmailAddress must be provided

NotificationMethod.description: Use this optional parameter to override the account-level setting for the eLinx delivery method. If not provided, the account-level setting will be used. Possible values: email, sms, whatsapp.

ReceiverEmailAddress.description: Customer's email address - Must be a valid email. Only required if SendNotification is true and NotificationMethod = email.

ReceiverPhoneNumber.description: Customer's phone number - Must be a valid number. Only required if SendNotification is true and NotificationMethod = sms or whatsapp.

IframeKey.description: An iFrame key generated from /iq11/generate-embed-url. If provided, the settings applied to this iFrame will be used when the customer provides their bank account information. If not provided, the default iFrame settings will be used.

FlexiblePaymentOptions.description: This will inform the end user of the flexible payment options that they can choose from. Input can be a comma-delimited list. The possible values are: multiple, partial, installments.

MinimumPaymentAccepted.description: This is the minimum amount that can be accepted for a 'partial' payment option. Example, if total eLinx amount is 100.00, and MinimumPaymentAccepted is 25.00, the user will be able to choose a partial payment of 25.00 (or more). This is required if 'partial' is included in FlexiblePaymentOptions.

RemainderPaymentDate.description: This will specify the date the remainder of the total amount should be paid if 'partial' payment is selected. This is optional if 'partial' is included in FlexiblePaymentOptions.

NumberOfInstallments.description: This will specify the number of installments that the payments will be split into. This is required if 'installments' is included in FlexiblePaymentOptions.

InstallmentFrequency.description: This will specify the frequency of installments. This is required if 'installments' is included in FlexiblePaymentOptions. The possible values are: weekly, biweekly, monthly.

SendReminder.description: Use this optional parameter to override the account-level setting for sending reminders to recipient. If not provided, the account-level setting will be used.

ReminderFrequency.description: Use this optional parameter to override the account-level setting for the eLinx reminder frequency (in days). If not provided, the account-level setting will be used.

RecipientMessage.description: Use this optional parameter to provide a message to the recipient.

PaymentMethodDisplayOptions.description: This optional parameter can be added to ensure that the recipient is using an existing payment method, adding a new payment method or whether the client has access to both. Valid options include - New, Existing or Both. Defaults to New.

OTPRequired.description: This optional parameter can be added to configure when to send an OTP for eLinx. By default OTP will be sent for existing payment methods only.

GLCode.description: An optional GL code to associate with the transaction created from this eLinx request.

TransactionTypeCode.description: An optional transaction type code to associate with the transaction created from this eLinx request.

Success.description: True if the sending was successful, false if it failed

ErrorMessage.description: Contains a description of the error if the request failed

ELinxRequestID.description: The unique ID of the eLinx request

Link.description: Contains a link where customer needs to go to provide the bank information

Status.description: Message indicating the current request status. Statuses are: pending, cancelled, completed

Amount.description: Amount of the eLinx, if provided

Note.description: If applicable, notes giving context to the transaction.

ClientReferenceNumber.description: The client reference number attached to the eLinx request, if applicable

ELinxRequestType.description: The type of eLinx request. eLinx request types are: beneficiary, scheduled, transaction.

Frequency.description: The frequency of the schedule (if applicable): single or recurring

NameOfFrequency.description: Name of the frequency of the transaction (if applicable): weekly, biweekly, monthly, bimonthly, 3 months, 6 months, yearly. Only provided if Frequency provided is recurring.

SemiMonthlyFrequencyType.description: Type of semi-monthly frequency (if applicable): SemiMonthFirstAndFifteenth, SemiMonthFifteenthAndLast.

ScheduleStartDate.description: Date from which the transaction will be started (if applicable)

ScheduleEndDate.description: Date which the transaction will end (if applicable)

EndingAfterPayments.description: Number of payments after which the transaction processing will end

PaymentType.description: Transaction type (if applicable): fund or withdraw

get.description: This endpoint is used to retrieve a listing of all eLinx requests.

parameters.name: ELinxRequestType
parameters.description: Filters results by eLinx request type: scheduled, transaction or beneficiary. Default is '' (i.e., all eLinx requests are returned).

parameters.name: ELinxRequestID
parameters.description: Filters results by eLinx request ID

parameters.name: StartDateTime
parameters.description: Filters results that occurred on or after this date/time. Can be specified in either YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS or YYYY-MM-DD format. Default is 30 days ago.

parameters.name: EndDateTime
parameters.description: Filters results that occurred on or before this date/time. Can be specified in either YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS or YYYY-MM-DD format. Default is the current date/time.

parameters.name: Limit
parameters.description: Limit the number of records that are returned.

parameters.name: Offset
parameters.description: Use this parameter to set the starting point in the dataset.

parameters.name: Timezone
parameters.description: Use this parameter to convert the time to the specified timezone. If no timezone is specified, the default is UTC.

ErrorMessage.description: Contains a description of the error if the request failed

CreditCardExpiryYear.description: Expiry year of the linked credit card

CreditCardExpiryMonth.description: Expiry month of the linked credit card

CreditCardBrand.description: Brand of the linked credit card

FlexiblePaymentOptions.description: Collection of flexible payment plan options

PaymentType.description: Type of elinx request. Possible values: fund, withdraw, or empty if no transaction is associated.

ClientAccountID.description: Client account ID associated with the eLinx request

GLCode.description: The GL code associated with the eLinx request, if applicable

TransactionTypeCode.description: The transaction type code associated with the eLinx request, if applicable

TotalRecords.description: Total number of eLinx records in that search range.

Offset.description: Use this parameter to set the starting point in the dataset.

Limit.description: Limit the number of records that are returned.

post.description: This endpoint is used to cancel an incomplete eLinx request

ELinxRequestID.description: The unique ID of the eLinx request you want to cancel

Success.description: True if the sending was successful, false if it failed

ErrorMessage.description: Contains a description of the error if the request failed

post.description: This endpoint is used to update the eLinx settings for an account.

ELinxSenderEmailAddress.description: The email address used as the sender for all eLinx notifications sent from your account

DefaultNotificationMethod.description: The default method used to deliver eLinx requests. Possible values: email, sms

ELinxReminderFrequency.description: How often (in days) to send reminders for pending eLinx requests

ELinxExpirationTime.description: How many days until an eLinx request expires if not completed. Set to 0 for no expiration

EnableELinxDecline.description: Whether recipients can decline eLinx requests

SenderNotificationsEnabled.description: Whether to send notifications to the sender when eLinx requests are completed or declined

ReceiverNotificationsEnabled.description: Whether to send notifications to the receiver for eLinx requests

ELinxReminderEnabled.description: Whether to send reminder notifications for pending eLinx requests

OTPRequired.description: When to send an OTP for eLinx. By default OTP will be sent for existing payment methods only.

Success.description: True if settings were updated successfully, false otherwise

ErrorMessage.description: Contains a description of the error if the request failed

get.description: This endpoint is used to retrieve a list of all eLinx settings.

Success.description: True if the sending was successful, false if it failed

ErrorMessage.description: Contains a description of the error if the request failed

EnableELinxDecline.description: Can customer's decline an eLinx request

ELinxExpirationTime.description: Expiration time (in days) of an eLinx request.

ELinxSenderEmailAddress.description: Default sender email address for eLinx requests.

ELinxReminderFrequency.description: Reminder Frequency (in days) of an eLinx request.
